name: home-assistant-sonoff-water-valve
description: Generate time-based Home Assistant automations and trigger a SONOFF water valve.

interface.shortDescription: Build timed Home Assistant schedules for a SONOFF water valve.
interface.longDescription: Creates Home Assistant YAML automations for time-based irrigation schedules and includes a script to call the Home Assistant REST API for manual or test runs.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Home Assistant schedule for my SONOFF valve.
Add a 6 AM and 6 PM irrigation run for 10 minutes.
Show me how to test the valve through the HA REST API.
